context: A married couple plans a movie-and-gift weekend
purpose: Teach: ハリウッド/トレンド/タレント/エアコン/チャット/ビタミン/ギフト/バトル

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 週末、子供たちにハリウッド映画見せに連れてくか。
lines.en: This weekend, should we take the kids to see a Hollywood movie?
lines.style: Light, easy offer. Warm but casual — not pushing, genuinely open to her take. Slight upward lilt on the question. Relaxed posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいね。あとパパに父の日のギフトもそろそろ選ばないと。
lines.en: That sounds good. And we should probably start picking out a Father's Day gift for your dad soon.
lines.style: Practical but affectionate. Gentle transition between topics — not abrupt. Warm undertone of 'we're in this together.' Steady pace, organized thinking.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: タレントが推してたビタミン補給グミとか、トレンドで流行ってるらしい。
lines.en: Those vitamin gummies the celebrities are pushing seem to be trending right now.
lines.style: Slightly amused, almost conspiratorial tone. Light on 'trending' — he's sharing an observation, not convinced. Easy pace. The wry husband noticing what the world is doing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家のエアコン、夏前に点検も入れておこう。
lines.en: We should also get the home AC serviced before summer gets here.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. No drama — just the next item on a mental list she's been carrying. Grounded, calm delivery. Responsible but not burdened.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 子供たちの友達ともグループチャットで連絡入れてやろう。
lines.en: I'll send a message to the kids' friends in the group chat about it.
lines.style: Warm, slightly playful. Takes on the task like it's part of his thing — being the social one. Natural, unhurried. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。日常のあれこれ、バトル感あるけど楽しいね。
lines.en: Yeah. The everyday stuff feels like we're juggling, but it's actually really good.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. She's reflecting on this moment — not performing, just real. Slight pause before 'good' like she's finding the right word. Tender close.
